intro: Sentinel Velene Starstrike is a night elf guardian stationed at Silverwind Refuge in central Ashenvale. Tasked with protecting the sanctuary and the surrounding waters, she confronts encroaching unnatural threats such as rogue elementals and foul sorcerers. Her vigilance helps safeguard the ancient woodland from corrupting magical interference.

p: Stationed beside the clear waters of Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike maintains a watchful vigil from Silverwind Refuge. Like many night elf sentinels scattered throughout Ashenvale, her primary duty is preserving the balance of the forest and repelling threats to elven sanctuaries. The serene grove serves as a vital rest stop for travelers traversing the central woods, making her presence essential to the area's ongoing safety.

The peace around Silverwind Refuge is fragile. Velene keeps close watch over Mystral Lake, where erratic elemental spirits and reckless mage summoners disrupt the natural rhythm of the wilderness. Through her direction, champions are dispatched to suppress rogue water elementals and put an end to the careless practitioners disturbing the spirits of the land.
